limitations: A grounded result associates one sampled surface point with a source object ID; it does not ground an entire box, mask, object interior or material.
The detector supplies a candidate pixel. Object association comes from the co-registered ID raster, not the detector class label or confidence.
Depth, calibration, ID association and source provenance are caller declarations; their input hashes provide consistency, not independent authentication or physical validation.
Missing depth, missing IDs, space behind the observed surface and space outside image bounds remain unknown, never empty.
Only rectified pinhole cameras and known-scale camera-Z depth in millimetres are supported. Ordinal, relative-scale and ray-range depth cannot be substituted.
Crop/resize coordinates use pixel centers and nearest source-pixel sampling. No depth interpolation, lens-distortion correction or segmentation model runs here.
